**[P2] Widen an already queued flush for later drains**

When one drain has already set `_flush_requested`, a record can subsequently be queued before another recordless drain enters. This branch does not extend `_flush_barrier`, so the worker can consume the older request, flush before exporting that newly pending record, and release the later drain because its own sequence is already satisfied. That contradicts the documented guarantee that a drain covers records pending when it starts and can leave buffered telemetry unflushed if the owning invocation never reaches its own drain. Snapshot `_seq` when each drain begins and extend an existing queued/next flush to cover records pending at that snapshot; only share an in-flight flush when it already covers that snapshot. Add this ordering as a scheduler regression test.
